# costory_billing_datasource_aiven (Resource)

Creates a Costory Aiven billing datasource. See the full documentation [here](https://docs.costory.io/setup/billing#aiven).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    costory = {
      source  = "costory-io/costory"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "costory_api_token" {
  type        = string
  description = "Costory API token."
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "aiven_api_secret" {
  type        = string
  description = "Aiven API token used to fetch billing data."
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "costory" {
  token = var.costory_api_token
}

resource "costory_billing_datasource_aiven" "main" {
  name            = "Aiven Billing"
  api_secret      = var.aiven_api_secret
  organization_id = "aiven-organization-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_secret` (String, Sensitive) Aiven API token used to fetch billing data.
- `name` (String) Billing datasource display name.
- `organization_id` (String) Aiven organization ID.

### Read-Only

- `bq_table_uri` (String, Sensitive) BigQuery table URI created by Costory for billing data.
- `id` (String) Billing datasource ID returned by Costory.
- `status` (String) Datasource status returned by Costory.
- `type` (String) Datasource type. Always `Aiven` for this resource.
